profile.headline: Sr SDET | Ex-Ebay| Ex-Verizon| Ex-AOL
profile.summary:
With a robust background encompassing 10 years of experience in Leading Software Testing I bring a wealth of expertise to of E-commerce, Video Streaming Services, and Telemedicine Platforms.

I possess a profound understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), encompassing both Waterfall and Agile methodologies. 

I have successfully led multiple teams simultaneously, conducting a diverse range of tests, including smoke, functional, regression, device, end-to-end (E2E), web apps, and compatibility testing. My expertise extends to the development and execution of comprehensive automation and manual test strategies, plans, scenarios, and cases. I leverage a variety of languages and tools such as Python, Java, Scala, PyTest, TestNg, ScalaTest, Rest assured, Postman, Jenkins, and SQL to achieve optimal testing outcomes.

Recognized for my exceptional performance and significant contributions to the company's success, I have received multiple awards in acknowledgment of my dedication and proficiency.

I am driven by a passion for expanding my knowledge and skills, and I am adept at working both independently and collaboratively within a team, demonstrating strong teamwork skills even with minimal supervision.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer in Test
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Led testing efforts, overseeing various tests such as smoke, functional, regression, device, E2E, web apps, and compatibility testing.
Significantly reduced overall testing time nearly by 50% by identifying process, technology challenges, and deficiencies, driving successful changes and strategic automation of test cases.
Developed and maintained a robust Test Automation Framework using Python and Java for multiple projects.
Advocated and introduced multiple processes within the organization which helped in enhancing overall testing coverage and effectiveness.
Developed test strategies, test plans, and test cases based on project requirements, ensuring alignment with quality objectives.
Coordinated testing efforts across multiple teams, conducting end-to-end testing to validate system integration and functionality.
Triaged, debugged issues, and documented defects effectively, collaborating closely with the Development team, Field Engineers for efficient defect resolution.
Estimated and planned testing efforts in collaboration with our QA Director and other leaders.
Actively participated in test design and test systems architecture discussions, providing valuable insights into the overall testing strategy.
Environment: Python, PyTest, Selenium, Appium, Test Flight, Java, TestNg, Git, Jenkins, Linux, Postman, CI/CD, REST APIs, SQL, Oracle DB, Selenium Webdriver, Jira, Docker, AWS, Twilio, PubNub,Postman, CI/CD, REST APIs

positions.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Develop Test Automation using Python Framework for multiple projects within Ebay Ecosystem.
Automate test cases using Java for internal framework (Breeze) 
Develop test and automation strategy and ensure testability.
Involved in  backend testing of Webservices/API, consumer, producer, batch jobs.
Involved in E2E testing and UI testing.
Hands on experience in querying DBs like - Oracle DB, NoSQL- NuData, Hadoop.
Understand the requirement and create test strategy, test plan and test cases.
Create CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins, Docker and integrate it using ECD.
Performance Testing using Jmeter.
Work with dev for releasing the build by doing smoke testing in Prod and PredProd after release and monitoring of logs(SRE)
Estimate testing effort, triage and debug issues.
Identify process, technology challenges and deficiencies that need to be addressed and drive those changes to successful adoption.
Participate in test design and test systems architecture discussions, proposes and discusses solutions to system and product changes that are related to domain area.
Document defects effectively and work with Development team to triage and troubleshoot defects.
Lead and Coordinate testing efforts across multiple teams.
Recipient of Skunk works Product Innovation Award for Expo conducted on 2019 for Ebay Eco project and bagged 7th place in Hackweek for Power of Invoice project.

Environment: Python, Java, PyCharm, Postman, JMeter, Git, CI, CD, Hadoop, NoSQL, SQL, Oracle DB, API, Webservices, IntelliJ, Jenkins, Kafka, Kibana.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Role 1: Software Development Engineer in Test
Responsibilities:
Test and Develop Automation tests for Voice Web Services and push notifications using Scala Test Framework and integrate in a CI environment using Jenkins and Travis.
Create instances in AWS for different services and perform Load Testing using Gatling framework for benchmarking and tuning the services.
Work closely with developers to understand and test new notification services.
Debug voice search related issues from client side and service side using Splunk logs, ngnix logs, crash logs.
Stimulate bad network and test setup box, BHR and voice search behavior. 
Closely work with developers to understand new features and develop test cases.
Perform weekly tagging of services for prod and qa environments.
Work with 3rd party vendors for coordinating and resolving issues.
Role 2:
Develop test automation  for REST-based,  high-scale  client facing multitenant  web services such as account management, recommendation, profile management, and search.
Perform Test development and automation using ScalaTest for Scala(Java8) based web services.
Conduct  black-box  testing,  white-box  testing,  scripting  to support  automated  testing,  and testing  of web-based applications.
Integrate Test execution into a continuous deployment environment using Jenkins.
Coordinate with the development  and products teams to understand the architecture  and Apis of the web services for both test automation and bug triage.
Provide  information  related  to the defects  by analyzing  Splunk  logs and help in its resolution,  and inform the Engineering team of trouble areas.
Perform manual testing for feature and bug verification prior to automation.

Environment: Scala, ScalaTest, Gatling, AWS-EC2, Git, Jenkins, Travis, Linux, Splunk, Elastic Search, Postman, Ngnix, Amazon RDS, Grafana,
